records.summary_text:
[CW note] From the CryptoWeeklies video of 22 July 2026.

[2026-07-22_AAVE]  
Video Title: AAVE Squeezes Into a 43% Lifetime TWAP Discount  
Video ID: x2sjcfKmgOs  
AAVE (AAVE) | Class: CRYPTO  

    Current Structure:  
    • Current trading price sits at $939, hovering near the upper band of its one‑standard‑deviation envelope, which spans $69 to $116 over the past week.  
    • The asset is trading at a 43% discount to its lifetime TWAP baseline, reflecting a steep pullback from recent highs.  
    • Short‑term SMA levels cluster around $850–$920, with a 20‑day moving average providing a modest support floor.  
    • Social sentiment analysis shows a surge in bullish chatter, with a word‑cloud density that has increased by roughly 22% over the last 30 days.  

    Macro Quantitative Risk:  
    • Regression fair‑value bands project a long‑term equilibrium near $190, while a 2029 parabolic projection places the asset between $750 and $800.  
    • The TWAP risk level is elevated, with a recent 150% spike in volatility that mirrored the peak of the last bull market at roughly $400k for BTC.  
    • Compound growth metrics indicate a 40% annualized return, whereas quantitative models project a 75% upside potential over the next cycle.  
    • The residual zone of undervaluation lies below $650, while overvaluation concerns emerge above $900.  

    Downside & Upside Targets:  
    • Machine‑learning forecasts suggest a potential downside floor near $650, with a panic‑drawdown threshold at $600.  
    • Non‑panic support is anchored at the 50‑day SMA, approximately $750, offering a buffer against short‑term volatility.  
    • Macro moving‑average supports point to a bullish cycle target of $1,200 if the asset re‑enters its upper TWAP band.  
    • The upside target is capped by the 2029 projection of $800, beyond which the risk of a mean‑reversion spike increases sharply.
